```{r}
library(clue)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(grid)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
## create the proportions of signature attributio across samples
msighdp_components_proportions<-read.csv('../Signatures/msigHDP_patients//02_Output/inferred.exposures.csv')%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='X')

msighdp_components_proportions<-as.data.frame(t(msighdp_components_proportions))%>%
  mutate(across(contains('hdp'),~.x / rowSums(as.data.frame(t(msighdp_components_proportions)))))%>%
  rownames_to_column('donor')%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=contains('hdp'))%>%
  mutate(name=factor(name,levels=c('hdp.4','hdp.3','hdp.2','hdp.1')))

hdp_component_prop<-ggplot(data=msighdp_components_proportions,aes(x=donor,y=value,fill=name))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity')+
  scale_fill_manual(breaks=c('hdp.1','hdp.2','hdp.3','hdp.4'),
                    labels=c('HDP_1','HDP_2','HDP_3','HDP_4'),
                    values=c('wheat3','maroon4','hotpink3','limegreen'))+
  scale_y_continuous(label=label_percent())+
  labs(y='Component contribution [%]',
       x='Donor ID',
       fill='HDP Components')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=20,face='bold'),
        legend.title=element_text(size=20,face='bold'),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=14,angle=90),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14),
        legend.position='bottom')
ggsave('../Signatures/msigHDP_patients///HDP_components.png',hdp_component_prop,width=24,height=8)
```

```{r}
# SigProfiler
sigprofiler <- read.delim(paste0("../Signatures/sigprofiler_sbs_patients//02_Output/SBS96/Suggested_Solution/SBS96_De-Novo_Solution/Signatures/SBS96_De-Novo_Signatures.txt"), check.names = FALSE)
rownames(sigprofiler) <- sigprofiler$MutationType
sigprofiler <- as.matrix(sigprofiler[, -1])

# mSigHdp (an ICAMS catalog object, or read from file)
msighdp <- read.delim("../Signatures/msigHDP_patients///02_Output/extracted.signatures.txt")
rownames(msighdp) <- msighdp$MutationType
msighdp <- as.matrix(msighdp[, -1])

stopifnot(setequal(rownames(sigprofiler), rownames(msighdp)))   # sanity check the conversion
msighdp <- msighdp[rownames(sigprofiler), , drop = FALSE]           # same row order

# make both proper probability distributions
sigprofiler  <- sweep(sigprofiler,  2, colSums(sigprofiler),  "/")
msighdp <- sweep(msighdp, 2, colSums(msighdp), "/")
colnames(msighdp)=seq(1,ncol(msighdp))

colnames(sigprofiler)  <- colnames(sigprofiler)
colnames(msighdp) <- paste0("HDP_", colnames(msighdp))

## create cosine similarity matrix:
cosim <- function(A, B) {
  A <- sweep(A, 2, sqrt(colSums(A^2)), "/")
  B <- sweep(B, 2, sqrt(colSums(B^2)), "/")
  t(A) %*% B
}
cosine_matrix <- cosim(sigprofiler, msighdp)   # rows = SigProfiler, cols = mSigHdp
cosine_matrix<-round(cosine_matrix, 3)
```

```{r}
k <- min(ncol(sigprofiler), ncol(msighdp))
assign <- solve_LSAP(cosine_matrix, maximum = TRUE)   # requires nrow <= ncol; transpose if not

matched <- data.frame(
  sigprofiler = colnames(sigprofiler),
  mSigHdp     = colnames(msighdp)[as.integer(assign)],
  cosine      = cosine_matrix[cbind(seq_len(nrow(cosine_matrix)), as.integer(assign))]
)

matched[order(-matched$cosine), ]
cosine_heatmap<-ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  cosine_matrix,
  name = "Cosine Similarity",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(0, 1, length.out = 100),
    viridisLite::viridis(100)
  ),
  column_title = "Cosine Similarity of msigHDP and SigProfiler Components",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = NA),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.text(
      round(cosine_matrix[i, j], 2),
      x, y,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
    )
  },
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Cosine Similarity",
    at = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  )
)

png('../Signatures/msigHDP_patients//signature_extraction_heatmap.png',width=800,height=600,res=100)
cosine_heatmap
dev.off()
```
Assess the cosine similarity of signature attribution with and without SBS89
```{r}
cosmic_included_cosine_similarities<-read.delim('../Signatures/msigHDP_patients//02_Output/Attribution_test/COSMIC_SBS89_included/Assignment_Solution/Solution_Stats/Assignment_Solution_Samples_Stats.txt')%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.Names, Cosine.Similarity)

cosmic_excluded_cosine_similarities<-read.delim('../Signatures/msigHDP_patients/02_Output//Attribution_test/COSMIC_SBS89_excluded/Assignment_Solution/Solution_Stats/Assignment_Solution_Samples_Stats.txt')%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.Names, Cosine.Similarity)

compare_similarities<-left_join(cosmic_included_cosine_similarities,cosmic_excluded_cosine_similarities,
          by='Sample.Names',suffix=c('_include_SBS89','_exclude_SBS89'))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=contains('Cosine'))%>%
  mutate(PD67981=Sample.Names=='PD67981')

compare_cosine_similarities<-ggplot(data=compare_similarities,aes(x=Sample.Names,y=value,fill=name,alpha=PD67981))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity',position='dodge')+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.9,1),expand = FALSE)+
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c(0.3,1),
                     labels=c('',''))+
  scale_fill_manual(breaks=c("Cosine.Similarity_include_SBS89", "Cosine.Similarity_exclude_SBS89"),
                    labels=c('Including SBS89','Excluding SBS89'),
                    values=c('skyblue4','chocolate2')
                    )+
  labs(y='Cosine Similarity',
       x='Donor ID',
       fill='Signature Profile',
       alpha='')+
  guides(alpha = "none")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=20,face='bold'),
        legend.title=element_text(size=20,face='bold'),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=14,angle=90,hjust=-0.5,vjust=0.5),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14),
        legend.position='bottom')
ggsave('../Signatures/msigHDP_patients//compare_sosine_similarieties.png',compare_cosine_similarities,width=24,height=9)
```
